title: Doom Warden
summary: Doom Warden is a shadowy, reptilian Titan with green skin and blue armor. This burly Titan wields a giant key as its primary weapon. Doom Warden was in the possession of Mr. Wilder until he gave it to one of his Suits.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Mr. Wilder]] gave Doom Warden's Amulet to [[Unnamed Suit 057]], with [[Unnamed Suit 054|Suit 054]] being given [[Shadow Agent]]. Doom Warden was invoked alongside Shadow Agent when the Suits attempted to capture [[Sophie Casterwill]]. Doom Warden injured Powerbonded [[Sabriel]], but she defeated him after her recovery. {{Source|Gremlow Infestation!}}

This Titan was again used by the same female suit while defending [[the Professor's castle]] from [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Den Fears]]. Doom Warden was defeated by Lok with the [[Willblade]]. {{Source|An Ally from the Organization}}

full_text:
Doom Warden is a shadowy, reptilian Titan with green skin and blue armor. This burly Titan wields a giant key as its primary weapon. Doom Warden was in the possession of Mr. Wilder until he gave it to one of his Suits. 

==History==
Mr. Wilder gave Doom Warden's Amulet to Unnamed Suit 057, with Suit 054 being given Shadow Agent. Doom Warden was invoked alongside Shadow Agent when the Suits attempted to capture Sophie Casterwill. Doom Warden injured Powerbonded Sabriel, but she defeated him after her recovery. [Gremlow Infestation!]

This Titan was again used by the same female suit while defending the Professor's castle from Lok Lambert and Den Fears. Doom Warden was defeated by Lok with the Willblade. [An Ally from the Organization]

==Abilities==
Doom Warden is an extremely strong Titan that uses a large key to smash his enemies. Doom Warden's special ability is Magnetic Fluid.

== Trivia ==
*Doom Warden's summoning command is "Suppress them."
*Doom Warden is based on a warden, which is a chief official in charge of a prison. Doom Warden's weapon is then like an unfair warden's prison's key.
